name: manual_ca867a
claim: Independent review of a bot-resolved thread needs the GitHub record, not hook output: GraphQL reviewThreads resolvedBy showed cursor[bot] resolved both orama 526 threads, yet the fix commit was the operator's, and it covered only the reported example. Fix the root cause once instead of per call site: extract command substitutions only where a shell would expand them (not single-quoted, not escaped), isolate each substitution's inner quoting, and state that it is a bounded lint, not a shell parser. In test design only the new false-positive regressions must fail before the patch; the controls must pass at both heads.
